name: app
title: Small Start app
description: Write once into an empty folder. The app owns its source, commands, and copied runtime.

files.content:
{
  "name": "tinker-app",
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vp dev",
    "build": "vp build",
    "start": "tinker serve",
    "doctor": "tinker doctor",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "postinstall": "tinker prepare",
    "gate:commands": "node node_modules/@tinker/start/lib/command-gate.mjs"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@tanstack/react-router": "1.170.41",
    "@tanstack/react-start": "1.168.60",
    "@tinker/core": "https://github.com/lagz0ne/tinkered/releases/download/start-v0.9.0/tinker-core-0.9.0.tgz",
    "@tinker/react": "https://github.com/lagz0ne/tinkered/releases/download/start-v0.9.0/tinker-react-0.9.0.tgz",
    "react": "^19.3.0",
    "react-dom": "^19.3.0",
    "zod": "^4.0.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@tinker/start": "https://github.com/lagz0ne/tinker-app/releases/download/start-v0.17.0/tinker-start-0.17.0.tgz",
    "@types/node": "^24",
    "@types/react": "^19",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19",
    "typescript": "^7.0.2",
    "vite": "npm:@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core@1.0.0",
    "vite-plus": "1.0.0"
  },
  "overrides": {
    "@better-auth/utils": "0.4.2",
    "better-call": "1.4.0",
    "typescript": "^7.0.2",
    "vite": "npm:@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core@1.0.0"
  }
}

# Config is typed tags, filled by the app command. This file defines no env requirements.
# Required tag: backendStop (the command owns its AbortController)
# Required tag: telemetrySide
# Required tag: telemetryService
# Required tag: tracesUrl
# Required tag: logsUrl
# Safe defaults: logLevel = info (30); spanHistory = 80.
# LOG_LEVEL takes 20 (debug), 30 (info), 40 (warn), or 50 (error).
# Read cmds/server.ts for the actual bindings and their inputs.
